items.quote: Every operator read route in CONN-04 to CONN-14 is served from the launcher's process and reuses the single `Databasise` on `app.state.engine` (no second engine, trace-store connection or registry).
The repo holds a machine-readable refusal catalogue, a static JSON file under docs/gui/.
The repo holds a checked-in selector-resolution fixture.
GET /info returns 200 with `{version, workspace, clients: {llm: bool, embedding: bool, rerank: bool}}`.
GET /wirings returns 200 with one row per candidate in `all_wirings()`
GET /ledger/aliases returns 200 with `[{alias, active_version, record_kind, generation_ordinal, created_at}]`
GET /traces?limit&offset returns `{items: [{trace_reference, created_at, partial, degraded, stop_reason}], total, next_offset}`, newest first
POST /promote/preview with `{alias, trace_ids, verb, change_origin}` returns 200 `{arm, mutation_class, next_version, promotable, reason}`.
POST /chunks with `{selector, limit, offset}` returns `{refs: [EvidenceRef], total, next_offset}`
POST /graph/nodes with `{selector, prefix, limit, offset}` returns `{nodes: [{id, degree}], total, next_offset}`
POST /graph/node with `{selector, node_id, limit, offset}` returns `{id, degree, edges: [{src, tgt, edge_types, weight}], next_offset}`.
The console can read a store-busy status without opening any store or running the v1 subprocess.
